checks.title: collects the h2 and h3 of the target in order, h3 a level deeper, and gives each its link

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#toc'); const nav = t.querySelector('nav.sf-contents'); const links = [...t.querySelectorAll('.sf-contents-link')]; return nav && nav.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'На этой странице' && links.map((a) => a.getAttribute('href')).join() === '#intro,#install,#cdn,#npm,#settings,#events,#a11y' && t.querySelector('a[href="#cdn"]').closest('li').dataset.depth === '1'; })()

checks.title: the first section is current at the top: aria-current location on its link, current is its id

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#toc'); const on = t.querySelectorAll('[aria-current="location"]'); return on.length === 1 && on[0].getAttribute('href') === '#intro' && t.current === 'intro'; })()

checks.title: a chosen link makes its section current and sends sf-contents-change once with {id, previous}

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#toc'); return t.current === 'events' && t.querySelector('[aria-current="location"]').getAttribute('href') === '#events' && location.hash === '#events' && document.activeElement === document.getElementById('events'); })()

checks.title: the compact button names the current section and opens and closes the list; Escape gives focus back

steps.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#compact'); const b = c.querySelector('.sf-contents-toggle button'); return c.getAttribute('data-open') === 'true' && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && c.querySelector('.sf-contents-list').getClientRects().length > 0 && /: /.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label')); })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#compact'); const b = c.querySelector('.sf-contents-toggle button'); return !c.hasAttribute('data-open') && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && document.activeElement === b && c.querySelector('.sf-contents-list').getClientRects().length === 0; })()

checks.title: toggle is refused while the layout is not compact
links written inside are the items

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#given'); const links = [...g.querySelectorAll('.sf-contents-link')]; return links.length === 2 && links[1].closest('li').dataset.depth === '1' && g.querySelectorAll(':scope > a').length === 0; })()
